messages.content: Hello. I am Chen. I want to go to Fuzhou.
Hello, Chen. I am the conductor. Where is your ticket?
Here is my ticket. It is to Fuzhou.
Good. When does your train go?
It goes at eight o'clock. It is morning.
Yes, it is eight o'clock now. You are on time.
The weather is hot today. I am sweating.
Well, Xiamen is hot in summer. You should drink water.
Okay. Do I sit in seat 12 or seat 13?
You sit in seat 12. It is next to the window.
Thank you. I will go to my seat now.

messages.content: Hello, Lin Lin. I am your cousin Wei Wei.
Oh, Wei Wei! It is very good to see you. How are you?
I am fine. Today is sunny. It is warm in Suzhou.
Yes, the weather is nice. I am happy. Did you visit your parents?
Yes, I went to my mother's house yesterday. She is very happy.
That is wonderful. Well, we had a big dinner yesterday. Did you eat?
Yes, we ate dumplings and braised pork. It was delicious.
Oh, I love pork and dumplings. By the way, is your mother well?
She is very healthy. She drinks tea every day. I am happy too.
I think that is good. You should come to my home later. We can drink tea.
Okay, I will come. Thank you, Lin Lin.
You are welcome. Let us go to the park now. It is quiet here.

messages.content: Hello. I am Lin Tao. I go to Beijing.
Hello, Lin Tao. Welcome! Yes, it is Beijing. It is cold today, but you are warm.
Yes, the weather is cold. I want to go to the city center.
Oh, I understand. You go to the city center? Good. You take this train now?
Yes, I have my ticket. It is for Platform 3.
That is good. I check the ticket. Yes, it is Platform 3. The train goes to Beijing Station.
Thank you. How long is the trip?
Well, it is about one hour. You get there fast. The train is very clean.
Good. Do I sit near the window?
Yes, you sit by the window. You see the ice and the snow outside. It is beautiful.
Okay. Where is the snack bar?
Oh, the snack bar is at the back of the train. You want noodles or hot tea?
I want hot tea, please. It is cold outside.

messages.content: Hello. I am Lin Tao. Where is Beijing?

Okay. Thank you very much. I am happy.
You are welcome, Lin Tao. Enjoy your trip to Beijing. Have a nice day.

Hello, Zhang. Yes, it is very nice. The leaves are yellow. I am happy to see you.

Yes, walking is fun. I will bring my son to the park next week.
That sounds nice. Good luck at the meeting. I think your idea will help many people.
Thank you, Uncle Wang. You are very kind. See you at the meeting.
See you there, Min. Have a nice day. Go home and rest with your baby.

messages.content: Hello Doctor. My name is Chen Wei. I feel very tired today.
Hello Chen Wei. I'm sorry to hear that. You look very tired. How long have you felt this way?
For two days. I work in Chengdu. The weather is very hot.

No, I drink tea. I like warm tea. I do not drink cold water.
I see. Warm tea is good, but you need cold water too. It's very important for your health. You should drink at least eight glasses of water.
Okay. But my stomach hurts. I cannot drink too much water.
Well, that is a problem. Maybe you have a stomach bug. Do you have a fever? Do you feel sick?
Yes, I have a fever. My head hurts. I want to go to the hospital.
Oh no. You should go to the hospital now. It is better to be safe. Do you have any medicine at home?
No. I am at the clinic. Can you help me?
Of course. I will give you some medicine. Please take this pill and drink some water. Go home and rest. Do not work today.

messages.content: Hello. I am Wang. It is Tuesday afternoon. I am in a lecture hall in Chongqing.
Hello, Wang! I am Li. I am sitting next to you. It is cold today. The winter wind is strong.
Yes. The teacher is speaking. He is teaching us English. I like this class.
Me too. Well, the teacher speaks very slowly. I can understand him. Do you like English?
I want to speak English well. I study hard. I read books and I write words.
That is good. You are smart. By the way, do you have lunch yet? I am hungry now.
I eat a bowl of rice noodles. It is hot and delicious. Do you want to eat?
Yes, I want noodles too. After class, we can go to the cafeteria. It is near the building.
Good idea. I like beef noodles. They are my favorite food. What do you like?
I like chicken noodles. But I also like hotpot. It is very spicy. Do you like spicy food?
I do not like it too much. It is too hot for me. I drink milk instead.
Oh, I see. That is okay. Well, the class is almost over. We should go to the cafeteria now.
Yes. Let us go. I will buy noodles. You can buy hotpot later if you want.
Great. I will wait for you. It is a nice day to eat outside. See you soon!

messages.content: Hello. I want to buy a gift for my sister.

messages.content: Hello, Grandma. I am Xia. I come from Kunming.
Hello, Xia! It is good to see you. The autumn weather is cool here. It is not hot like Kunming.

Well, tea is very good. I drink tea every morning. Thank you for your gift.

Yes, I do. It's my favorite food. Well, I also make dumplings sometimes.

Yes, you know, they are very fresh. I make them with pork and cabbage.
Can I help you make them?
That is very kind of you. Please help me roll the dough. It is fun to do together.

Thank you. I am hungry now. Let me eat.

messages.content: Hello, Grandma Li. I am Wei. I am happy to see you.
Hello, Wei. I'm very happy too. It is cold today, isn't it? You look cold. Come here.
Thank you. I am from Chengdu now. It is snowing outside.
Oh, snow in Chengdu? That is rare. Well, you know, my kitchen is warm. I am cooking food.
What are you making? Do you make jiaozi?
Yes! I am making jiaozi. It is my favorite food. I put pork and cabbage inside. It is very tasty.
That sounds good. Where is the family coming from?
Well, my son is coming from Shanghai. He is very busy, but he came home for New Year.
Is your daughter here? Her name is Fang, right?
Yes, that's right! Her name is Fang. She is here now. She is cutting the vegetables. She is fast.
I love dumplings. Can I help you? I want to learn.
Of course! You know, learning is fun. You can fill the dough. But be careful, it is hot water.
Okay. I will try. Thank you, Grandma Li. It is nice to be with family.
Yes, family is important. We eat together. Let's eat soon. I hope you like the jiaozi!

messages.content: Hello, Grandma Li. I am Wei. It is very cold outside.
Hello, Wei. I am happy to see you. Yes, Chengdu is cold in winter. Come here. I am cooking jiaozi for dinner.
Wow, the jiaozi smell so good. Do you make them by hand?
Yes, of course. I make them every year for the New Year. It is a happy tradition. My hands are very fast. You know, I used to make them when I was young too.
That is nice. Can I help you? I want to learn how to make them.
You are very kind. Please wash your hands first. Then we will make the dough together. It is fun to do with family.
Okay. Where are my gloves? My hands are very cold.
Here, take these warm gloves. Well, my husband's old gloves are still good. Put them on. Now, look at the flour on the table.
The flour is white. Do we mix it with water? I think so.
Yes, that is right. You are good at this. We mix the flour and water slowly. Oh, the kitchen is warm now because of the stove.
It is warm. I like this family dinner. We eat together every year.
Yes, family is very important. My sister and her children will come soon. They will bring lucky money for everyone. It is a big day.
I am happy for them. Can we eat now? I am hungry.
Not yet. Wait a little bit. The jiaozi need to boil for ten minutes. Then we can eat and drink hot tea. It is delicious.

messages.content: Hello, Driver Zhang. Where is Bus Number 5?
Hello, Jing. We are at Xiguan Bus Station. It is busy today.
Oh, it is very crowded. I want to go to Tianhe.
Yes, you are right. Please wait here. I will buy a ticket for you.
Thank you. Do I need a subway card?
No, you do not need a card. This is a bus ticket. It is cheap.
Good. Where do I sit on the bus?
You can sit anywhere. The seats are near the door. Please sit there.
Okay. Is the air conditioning on?
Yes, it is on. It is cool inside. We are leaving now.
Great. How long does it take to the subway station?
It takes about ten minutes. We will stop at Tianhe soon.
Perfect. Thank you for helping me.
You are welcome. Please enjoy your ride, Jing.

messages.content: Hello, Driver Zhang. I want to go to Tianhe District.
Hello, Jing. Yes, I drive bus number 5. Where do you want to get off?
I get off at Haizhu Square. Please stop there.
Okay. You can buy a ticket at the machine first. It is cheap.
I have my card. Do I need to buy a paper ticket?
No, you do not. You can tap your card. It is very fast.
Oh, I see. I tap my card now. Please, let me on.
Welcome on board. Please, sit down there. The bus is moving.
Thank you. The road is busy today. It is raining.
Yes, it is raining in Guangzhou. You know, take your umbrella.
I have my bag. I sit quietly. Where are we going now?
We are going to Liuhua Road. It is near Haizhu Square. Sit tight.
Okay. I wait for the next stop. Please stop soon.
Here we are. Haizhu Station. Please, get off the bus. Thank you.

Hello, Xiao. Yes, we have many fresh vegetables today. The sun is nice.
Good. I also want to pick some tofu.
Of course. Look at that box of tofu. It is very white and soft.
Okay. How much is one block of tofu?
One block is five yuan. Please, you take the soft tofu.
Thank you. Now I want to buy green onions.
Yes, the green onions are fresh. They are long and green.
How many do I need? Do I want two or three?
Well, three is good for your lunch. You can cook soup.
Yes, three is good. I will take three.
Okay, here is your tofu and your green onions. It is ready.
Thank you. How much is the total price?
It is fifteen yuan. Please, you pay me with cash.
Here is twenty yuan. How much change?
Five yuan. Here is your change. Bye, Xiao.

messages.content: Hello Grandmother. It is cold here. I am back in Chengdu.
Hello, Wei Lin. I am so happy to see you. It is very cold in the small town today. The wind is strong.
Yes, it is windy. Did you make dumplings for the family reunion?

That sounds delicious. I want to eat them now. Do you have hot tea?

Thank you. My father is coming soon. He is on the bus line.
Oh, your father is coming? That is great news. He will see the dumplings. I think he will be very happy.
I am tired. I walked a lot on the subway. But I am happy to see you.
It is okay. You can rest here. I will cook more food for you. Please sit down and have some tea.
Good idea. Let us sit by the window. The street lights are nice.
Yes, the lights are bright and warm. We are talking about your family. You are a good grandson, Wei Lin.
Thank you. I will visit you again next month. I miss you very much.
I will miss you too. You are my favorite grandson. Come and eat the dumplings now.

messages.content: Hello Grandma. I am Wei Ming. I am happy to see you.
Hello, Wei Ming! You're here! I'm very happy. Come to the kitchen. I am cooking dumplings.
Oh, dumplings! I love dumplings. Do you make them every day?
No, not every day. Well, on Sunday evening, I make them for my family. It is special.
My parents are busy. They work at the bank. They do not eat dumplings often.
Oh, I understand. You work hard. By the way, how is your mother? Is she healthy?
She is fine. She drinks tea every morning. The weather in Chengdu is cold today.
Yes, it's winter. It is very cold. You should wear a warm coat. Are you cold?
I am not cold. I have a thick jacket. But I want hot soup. Is there soup?
Of course! There is hot soup. I will make tomato egg soup for you. It is hot and good.
Thank you, Grandma. I want to help you. Can I wash the vegetables?
Yes, you can! Please wash the cabbage. Oh, and eat some fruit. Apples are good for you.
Okay. I wash the cabbage. I eat an apple. The dumplings are ready now.
Yes! Well, they are fresh and hot. You know, they taste very good. Eat eat them now.

messages.content: Hello Grandma Zhang. I am Wei Ming. I am back!
Oh, hello Wei Ming! I'm so happy to see you. You look tired. Did you travel far from Chengdu?
Yes, I took the high-speed train. It was fast. I miss my parents.
Well, it's good to see you again. Your father and mother are in the other room. They want to see you.
Great! Can I eat something first? I am very hungry.
Of course! I am cooking hotpot now. We use fresh tofu and lots of vegetables. It is warm in winter.
I love hotpot! Do we eat dumplings too? I want to eat dumplings.
Yes, of course! I made big dumplings for you. I put pork and cabbage inside. They are very fresh.
Thank you Grandma. Are you healthy? Do you feel cold?
I am fine, thank you. I wear a thick sweater. It is cold here in Chunxi Road neighborhood. I drink hot tea.
That is good. Let us eat together now. I am ready.
Perfect! Come sit at the table. We have rice and soup too. It's a nice Sunday evening.

Yes, of course. Here is the change. You pay ten yuan. The rest is back to you. Have a nice day!
Thank you, Vouang. Goodbye.
Goodbye, Huang Ling! See you next time. The fruit shop is open tomorrow too.

Hello, Wei Ming. Oh, it is a nice evening in Chengdu. You look tired. Did you cook dumplings with your parents?
Yes, we did. My father made pork and chive dumplings. They are delicious.

Yes, we drink jasmine tea. It is sweet. My mother sits on the sofa and smiles.
Oh, that is wonderful. You know, my family usually eats Mapo Tofu tonight. Is your family big?
Yes, we have five people. My grandparents, my parents, and I. My grandmother is eighty years old.
Wow, that is a big family. I think you should visit them often. The weather is cool today. Do you walk in the park?
Yes, we walk near Jialing River. The water is blue. My sister likes the flowers there.
Oh, the river is beautiful. By the way, do you take the bus or the subway to go home?
I take the subway. Line 3. It is fast. My parents are very kind.
That is good. Subways are very fast in Chengdu. I am happy to see you, Wei Ming. Have a good time with your family!

Hello, Hao. Yes, I know you. How is your day? It is rainy today in Guangzhou.

Yes, I have a blue bag. It is big. I can put many food boxes.
That is good. Well, the food is hot and fresh. Where are you now? Are you at the station?
No, I am at Tianhe Park. I am waiting for a customer.
Oh, okay. Tianhe is far from the center. You take a long time. Do you need a map?
No, I have a phone. I see the route. I am tired now.
You work hard every day. I think you need a break. When do you finish work today?
I finish at five. I go home and eat dumplings. They are delicious.
Dumplings are great! Yes, well, eat some hot food. It warms you up. See you at the station.

messages.content: Hello. I am Jun. I want to go to my school. Is it easy?
Hello, Jun. It's not easy. The line is very crowded. Do you have a ticket?
No, I do not have a ticket. How can I buy one?
Well, you can buy a card at the machine. The machine is near the door. Do you see it?
Yes, I see the machine. I put my money. But I do not know how.
Okay. First, you press the red button. Then, you put the money in. It's very simple.
Oh, I understand. I put the money. But the screen says error.
Oh no. The machine is broken. You can ask a person for help. Where is the ticket office?
I see the office. But it is far. I am in a hurry. Can I take Line 2?
Yes, Line 2 is good. It goes to your school. But you need a ticket first. Do you want to try again?
Yes, I try again. I press the button. The card comes out. Thank you!
That's great! You are very smart. Now, go to Line 2. It's not far from here.
I go now. Have a good day. Goodbye!
Goodbye, Jun. Good luck at school. It's a nice day for riding the metro.

That is not enough. You need vegetables and meat too.
Okay. How many days will I rest?
You need to rest for two days. Please take this medicine.
Thank you Doctor Li. I will be good.

Of course! You can buy them at a shop near Binhu Park. It's not far from your home.
Okay. How much is one racket? Do you know?

I will buy them this weekend. The weather is sunny.
That sounds fun! Spring is a good time to play outside. I'm happy for you.
Thank you. When can I join your club?

Great! I will see you next Tuesday. Bye.

messages.content: Hello, Coach Qiang. My name is Li Xing. I am a student in Wuxi. I want to learn ping pongang.
Hello, Li Xing. I'm Coach Qiang. I am happy to help you. Well, pingi is a very good sport. Do you like it?
Yes, I like it. But I do not have a racket. Where can I buy one?
It is easy. You can go to the sports store in Binhu District. It's near the big park. The rackets are not expensive. I think you can buy one today.
Okay. What kind of racket do I need? I am new.
You know, you need a light wood racket. It is good for beginners. By the way, do you have a pair of sports shoes? You need them too.
I have one pair of shoes. They are red. Are they okay?
They look nice. Red is a good color. Actually, it is important to have good shoes. If you fall, you don't hurt your feet. Let's go to the store now.
Great. How much is the racket? I want to know the price.
Well, the price is about one hundred yuan. It is not much. Oh, you can also buy some balls. We need balls to play.
Yes, I want balls too. Do you play pingi often, Coach Qiang?
Yes, I play every afternoon. The weather is nice in spring. It is warm and sunny. I play with many students from the university.
That sounds fun. Can I join your club? I want to practice with you.
Of course! I am very happy to have you. We will meet tomorrow afternoon. You can come to the center in Binhu. It's near the bus stop. See you then.

messages.content: Hello, Auntie Zhang. I am Wei.

Okay. I will come next week.

Me too. Dinner will be very nice tonight.
Yes, it will be. We will eat dumplings and drink hot tea. It is a nice evening in Chengdu. Come and wash your hands.

That looks good. But one kilo is expensive. How much is it?
It is fifty yuan. Oh, it is a little high. Well, I can give you a discount. How about forty yuan?
Forty yuan is okay. But I want red dates too. How much for red dates?
Red dates are thirty yuan for one kilo. They are very healthy. You know, your mother likes them. I have many bags.
Yes, my mother likes them. I want half kilo. Can I pay with cash?
Of course. Cash is fine. Here, take half kilo for fifteen yuan. Thank you. Enjoy your snacks.
Thank you very much. The snacks are fresh. My mother is happy. Goodbye.
Goodbye, Chen Li. You are welcome. It is nice to meet you. Come back soon in winter.

messages.content: Hello. I am Chen Li. My mother wants to buy snacks.

Great. How much is one kilo of dried plums?

That is a lot. Can I pay thirty yuan for two kilos?
Oh, no, thirty is too much. Well, let me give you a good price. Two kilos are only twenty-five yuan. It is cheaper.
Okay. Twenty-five yuan. I have cash. Here is the money.
Thank you. Here are the dried plums. They are very sweet. By the way, do you want roasted chestnuts too?
Yes, please. My mother likes them. How much are they?
Ten yuan for one bag. It is very hot now. You can warm them at home. Here is your bag of chestnuts.
Thank you. I am very happy. I will go home now.
You're welcome, Chen Li. Have a nice day. See you next time at the market near Green Lake Park.

messages.content: Hello nurse. I am not good today.

Well, a headache can be bad. Did you drink water this morning?

Is the hospital far from Gulou station?
No, it is not far. You can walk there. It is only ten minutes.
Can I take medicine at home first?
Yes, you can. But please check your blood pressure first. It is important.

Oh dear, that is high. Please come back soon. Do not worry too much.
Thank you nurse. You are very kind.
You are welcome, Mr. Zhang. I will see you later. Take care of yourself.

messages.content: Hello nurse. I am Zhang Wei. My head hurts.

It is here. I have a headache. It started this morning.

I have some pills. But I do not know if I should take them.
Well, you should rest today. Please drink some warm water. It will help.
Thank you nurse. I will go home now. It is late.

messages.content: Hello. My name is Xia Ya. I am in Guilin with my family.
Hello, Xia Ya. It's nice to meet you. The sun is shining today. It is very hot.
Yes, the sun is hot. I feel very hot too. We are walking on Yanjiang Street.
Well, Yanjiang Street is very busy. Many people are walking. You should drink cold water.
Oh, I drink cold water now. It is good. Do you like hot tea?
Yes, I like hot tea. But it is too hot today. I drink cold water. It is fresh.
I want some cold water. Is there a store near here? I am thirsty.
Yes, there is a store. You can buy water there. Or you can buy fresh fruit. Do you like lychees?
Lychees? I like them. They are sweet. But I need water first.
Of course. Water is good first. You can eat lychees after. The air is humid today.
Yes, the air is wet. My hair is wet. Thank you for your help.
You are welcome. Guilin is beautiful in summer. We can take a boat on the Li River later.
That sounds fun. I want to see the river. Thank you very much.
You're welcome. Have a nice day, Xia Ya. Let's go to the river now.

messages.content: Hello. I want to eat noodles here. Please.
Hello, Zhang Lei. Yes! We have fresh soup noodles today. It smells good, you know.
I like soup noodles. Do you have chicken?
Yes, of course. We have chicken soup noodles. Would you like one bowl? Here is the menu.
Yes. One bowl, please. The soup is hot, right?
Yes, it is very hot! Oh, be careful. You should blow on the soup first. It is from our kitchen.
Thank you. I eat with chopsticks. They are wood.
That is right. You use chopsticks for noodles. Well, it is nice weather today. Do you like the lake view?
Yes. Xuanwu Lake is near here. I work near the lake.
Oh, really? That is convenient. The leaves are yellow now. Autumn is nice in Nanjing, isn't it?
Yes. But the soup is too hot. Please give me a spoon.
Of course. Here is a spoon. You can drink the soup with it. It is very tasty.

messages.content: Hello. I want to buy vegetables. Where is the market?
Hello, Xiao. It's Longqi Market. It is here, you know.

Yes, Zhengzhou is hot in summer. Please, drink sweet tea. It is cold.
Good idea. Do you sell dumpling skins? I want to make lunch.
Yes, I do. I make them every day. Well, you can buy them now.
I will buy five packets. Thank you. My family will eat them.
Okay, here are five packets. You are welcome. I'm selling fresh food.
Thank you. See you later. I go home to cook now.
Have a nice day, Xiao. The dumplings will be delicious. Bye!

messages.content: Hello! I want to buy vegetables for lunch.

Yes, the pork is very good! I think you should try the dumplings later.
Great! I want to make jiaozi at home.

Sure! Here is sweet tea. It is cold and nice. You are welcome.
Thank you. I will go home and cook now.
Goodbye! Have a nice lunch. See you tomorrow!

messages.content: Hello. I am Jian. I want to go to the park today.
Hi, Jian. Yes, it is a good idea. The weather is nice in Dali now. I like the park too.

Okay. I want to fly a kite. Do you have a kite?

Yes, I like Chinese tea very much. It is hot and good.
Great! I will buy some roasted tea leaves. We can sit under a tree and drink.
I am happy. Let us go to the lake now. It is autumn.
Yes, it is autumn. The leaves are yellow. It is a perfect time for a picnic. Let us go!

Hello, Hua. Yes, it is the Mid-Autumn Festival. The moon is very big and bright.
I like to watch lanterns. Look, there are many red lanterns.

Can I try this one? It looks good.
Sure. Here you are. It is a lot of fun. You know, the flavor is very good.
The weather is cool. It is good for the park.
Yes, Nanjing is cool in autumn. It is not too hot. We can walk by the lake.
I want to set off fireworks. Is it allowed here?
Well, I think we should wait. The fireworks are far away. You can see them from here.
Okay. I watch the fireworks. They are very loud.
Right. The sky is colorful now. It is a special night for everyone.

messages.content: Hello. It is Mid-Autumn Festival night. I like to eat mooncakes.
Hello, Hua. Yes, it is a special time. Well, I'm a volunteer here. I help people watch lanterns.
Oh, you are nice. Is it warm outside? I want to walk on the grass.
It is cool tonight. The wind is gentle. You know, the sky is very clear. You can see many stars.
I see. Do you like fireworks? My family sets them off at home.
Yes! Fireworks are very beautiful. Actually, we can watch them from the hill near the lake. It is safe there.
That is good. Where is the hill? I want to go there now.
It is behind the big tree. I am near the gate. You can walk five minutes. It is very close.
Five minutes? Wow. I walk fast. Can I buy water?
Of course. There is a small shop. It sells tea and water. You can buy a bottle for five yuan.
Thank you. I will drink tea first. Then we go to the hill.
Right. Tea is good for you. Well, let's go now. The moon is so big tonight.

messages.content: Hello, Mom. I am at work today. I am busy.
Oh, I understand. You are busy. But you come home for dinner. I am cooking dumplings.
Yes, I want to eat. But I am tired. I want to sleep.
Well, you cannot sleep now. We have a family dinner. Your grandma is coming too.
Grandma? Oh, she is in my town. I can visit her tomorrow.
No, she is coming to Chongqing today. She lives in a small town near here. She wants to see you.
Oh, she is old. She walks slowly. I must help her.
Yes, of course. You give her a red envelope too. It is the New Year holiday.
I do not have money. I am a student. I give zero money.
You give some money. Or you give a big red packet. Your dad gives you money now.
Okay. I will ask my dad. I go home now.
Good. I put the dumplings on the table. They are hot. Come and sit.

messages.content: Hello Grandma. I bring dumplings today.
Hello, Jun! Yes, I am making dumplings in the kitchen.
I make them very fast. My hands are good.
Oh, Jun, your hands are so strong! But I need help folding.
Okay. I fold them. Where is the flour?
It is on the table. The flour is white. You can take it.
I put flour on my hands. It is very sticky.
Yes, it is sticky. Wash your hands with water later.
I put meat and cabbage inside. It smells good.
That is my favorite food! I like meat and cabbage dumplings.
I cook them in a big pot. The water is boiling now.
Good, Jun! The water is boiling. Please put them in carefully.
They float up. I eat one now. It is hot!
Yes, it is hot. Blow drink some warm tea with it, Jun.

messages.content: Hello doctor. I have a cold. My throat hurts.
Hello, Xiao Lin. I'm sorry to hear that. It's hot in Kunming today.
Yes, it is. I drink too much water. I feel sick.
Well, drinking too much cold water is bad. Do you want to drink herbal tea?
Maybe. I like ginger tea. It is warm. I want to buy it.
Yes, ginger tea is good for your throat. Go to the pharmacy near you.
Okay. Is there a pharmacy on Xijiao Road?
Yes, there is. It is small but nice. You can walk there.
Great. I will walk there. Thank you very much.
You are welcome. Please rest at home. Drink warm water.
